 def has_liberty(board, r, c, color):
     q = deque([(r, c)])
     seen = set([(r, c)])
     while q:
         cr, cc = q.popleft()
         for dr, dc in [(0,1),(0,-1),(1,0),(-1,0)]:

             if board[nr, nc] == 0:

             if board[nr, nc] == color and (nr, nc) not in seen:
                 seen.add((nr, nc))
                 q.append((nr, nc))
     return False

     seen = set([(r, c)])

             elif board[nr, nc] == color and (nr, nc) not in seen:

                 q.append((nr, nc))
     return len(libs)

                 q.append((nr, nc))
